broadcast_title: Episode 1: The $599 Business Mainframe (Mac Mini + Local n8n)
ticker: BREAKING: EPISODE 1: THE $599 BUSINESS MAINFRAME (MAC MINI + LOCAL N8N)  ★  15 SAVE THE CAT! BEATS IN 16:9 UHD  ★  AUTONOMOUS TV BROADCAST ACTIVE
teleprompter_script:
[HOOK 0:00-1:15]
Russell holds up a Mac Mini on camera next to a printed stack of SaaS invoices totalling $1,800/month.
"This little box costs $599 once. Today, it's replacing all of this. Zero recurring fees, 100% data privacy."

[ARCHITECTURE 1:15-3:30]
Walk through the Sovereign Biz Box architecture. Show the 33 open-source microservices, the n8n command center running on localhost:5678, and zero recurring fees.

[EXECUTION 3:30-9:30]
Run 'make start' in terminal. Watch the n8n engine spin up on Node 20. Show the 3-node connected pipeline executing local Python microservices with zero-trust token protection.

[CUSTOMIZATION 9:30-13:00]
Show viewers how to download the starter repo, drop their own business details in, and have a running mainframe in under 10 minutes.

[CTA & COMMUNITY CHALLENGE 13:00-15:00]
"Drop a comment with your business type and the software bill you hate most. In next week's episode, I'll pick one subscriber's business and build a complete turnkey automation system live on camera." Link to booking for high-ticket consulting.
